name: CARTIER DE SANTOS LEATHER
description:
Cartier Santos – Quartz Watch

The Cartier Santos is a timeless icon of watchmaking, known for its distinctive square case, exposed bezel screws, and refined, sophisticated look. Whether you’re dressing up for a special occasion or adding a polished touch to your everyday style, this watch makes a confident statement.

Powered by a reliable quartz movement, it delivers accurate timekeeping with minimal maintenance, so you can wear it every day without worry.

Strap Width: 20 mm
Clasp/Buckle Width: 18 mm

name: OLEVS COUPLE WATCH
description: Celebrate your bond with this stunning OLEVS couple watch set, featuring matching designs for him and her. The luxurious silver and gold-tone stainless steel bracelets, elegant black dials, sparkling crystal markers, and classic Roman numerals create a sophisticated look for every occasion.

name: GALAXY TANK -GOLD
description:
Galaxy Watch 
The Galaxy watch is a small, elegant piece that adds a touch of sparkle to any outfit. Its compact 28 mm dial sits neatly on the wrist, and the soft fiber and silicone strap with a magnetic butterfly lock makes it comfortable to wear and quick to put on and take off.

Specifications

Model: Galaxy
Dial Size: 28 mm
Strap Width: 18 mm
Strap Build: Fiber and silicone
Lock Type: Magnetic butterfly lock

name: HUBLOT SKELETON-BROWN
description:
Hublot Skeleton Watch

The Hublot Skeleton is made for people who love seeing how a watch works. Its open skeleton dial shows the movement inside, and the automatic movement is powered by the motion of your wrist, so there is no battery to replace. The 38 mm dial is a balanced size, and the leather and silicone strap makes it comfortable to wear all day.

Specifications

Model: Hublot Skeleton
Dial Size: 38 mm
Movement: Automatic
Strap Build: Leather and silicone

premiumBoxes.name: ROLEX YATCH MASTER BOX
premiumBoxes.heading: Horizon Vault
premiumBoxes.description: Featuring a sleek matte-black carbon fiber exterior paired with ocean-blue Italian full-grain leather, this ultra-modern, lockable case includes a precision watch cushion and an integrated compartment for extra links and warranty cards.

description:
Crafted for Excellence
Striking Aesthetic: The high-contrast black dial features oversized Chromalight hour markers, casting a long-lasting luminescent glow that ensures perfect readability in low-light environments.
Signature Bezel: The bidirectional rotatable bezel is equipped with a matte black Cerachrom insert in ceramic, sporting polished, raised numerals and graduations that catch the light with subtle brilliance.
Innovative Oysterflex Bracelet: Engineered to offer the durability of a metal bracelet with the flexibility of a rubber strap, it utilizes a patented flexible metal blade
overmolded with high-performance elastomer for unparalleled wrist comfort.
